scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/task.mjs services/api/alembic.ini -- uv run --package klick alembic -c services/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.db:seed: node scripts/task.mjs services/api/src/klick/core/seed.py -- uv run --package klick python -m klick.core.seed
scripts.api:dev: node scripts/task.mjs services/api/src/klick/main.py -- uv run --package klick uvicorn klick.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.worker:dev: node scripts/task.mjs infra/compose/workers.yml -- docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f infra/compose/workers.yml --profile core up worker-default worker-media worker-ai-cpu worker-publish scheduler
scripts.web:dev: node scripts/task.mjs apps/web/package.json -- pnpm --filter web dev
scripts.desktop:dev: node scripts/task.mjs apps/desktop/package.json -- pnpm --filter desktop dev
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/task.mjs tests/e2e/package.json -- pnpm --dir tests/e2e test
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:py && pnpm lint:js && pnpm lint:design
scripts.lint:py: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy
